title: The number tiles on Today open a list, but look like plain number cards
what: Each tile in Your numbers (fees collected, new members, busiest hours and so on) opens the list behind that number when tapped. On screen a tile is a flat card with a big number, a small heading, a grey line and a little picture. There is no arrow, no 'See list' and no underline, so a first-time owner reads them as a report and may never find the lists behind them. A screen reader does hear 'Open the list'.
expected: A tile that opens a list shows it, for example with the arrow other tappable rows in the panel use, or a 'See who' line.
fix_line: Add an arrow or a 'See the list' line to each number tile

title: With the keyboard, the bell panel does not take the focus, and closing it loses your place
what: Pressing the bell opens the Notifications panel, but the keyboard focus stays on the bell. When the panel is closed with Escape while the focus is inside it, the focus is not put back on the bell, so a keyboard or screen reader user starts again from the top of the page. The panel's spoken name is always the English word 'Notifications', also in Hinglish.
expected: Opening the panel moves the focus into it, closing it puts the focus back on the bell, and the panel's spoken name follows the chosen language.
who: owners and staff using a keyboard or screen reader
how_often: every time the bell is used with the keyboard
fix_line: Move the focus into the bell panel when it opens and back to the bell when it closes, and translate its name

title: Dark | Light and English | Hinglish are announced as pick-one lists, but the arrow keys do nothing
what: Both switches tell a screen reader they are a pick-one list. In such a list people expect the arrow keys to move between choices. Here the arrow keys do nothing, and each choice is a separate Tab stop. This is on the first screen, in the top bar and in Settings.
expected: Either the arrow keys move between the two choices, or the choices are announced as plain buttons with on or off.
who: owners and staff using a keyboard or screen reader
fix_line: Add arrow key movement to the two switches, or make them plain on/off buttons

title: The side menu's group headings, 'More below' and the 'Pay now' link are smaller than the panel's finger-size rule
what: The panel's own rule is 44 points for anything tapped. The side menu's group headings, which fold a group, are 20 to 22 points tall, and 'More below' is 28. The 'Pay now' words on the stopped-paying line on Today, and on the MettleUp billing card, are a plain text link one line tall, also on a phone.
expected: Every tappable thing is at least the panel's finger size, most of all 'Pay now', which an owner whose gym is about to be locked will need.
fix_line: Give 'Pay now' the button look and the group headings and 'More below' more height

title: 'Not now' on the put-on-your-phone card hides it for good and never says where to find it again
what: On a phone, Today shows a card to put the admin app on the home screen. Its button says 'Not now', which sounds like it will come back, but tapping it hides the card on that device for good. The card does not say the same help is in Settings.
expected: Either the card comes back later, or the card says it can still be found in Settings.
who: owners and staff on a phone
fix_line: Add a line saying the install help stays in Settings, or call the button 'Hide'

title: The 'Your gym is ready' card shows once and never says where the gym code and join link live after
what: Right after a gym is made, a card shows the gym code, the join link, its QR and Share. It is shown only once: closing it with Done, the cross or Escape ends it. The card does not say that the same code and link stay under Settings, Invite members. Only the 'Open the QR poster' button hints at it.
expected: The card says where the code and link can be found again, for example 'You can find this any time in Settings, Invite members'.
fix_line: Add one line saying the code and link stay in Settings, Invite members
